verdict.rationale: Google Calendar offers a public REST API, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test mode or isolated non-production environment. Creating secondary calendars is at most a user-side workaround for keeping test data apart, not a documented sandbox, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
